title: kbmon's ask and claim times show in local time or say UTC
goal: The time kbmon's needs-you line prints for an ask reads `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC`, so a time in UTC is not read as local

run:
import atexit,shutil,tempfile
_m=tempfile.mkdtemp
def _d(*a,**k):
 d=_m(*a,**k);atexit.register(shutil.rmtree,d,True);return d
tempfile.mkdtemp=_d
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import mon_needs
ask = {"id": "A1", "since": "2026-10-27T22:39:36Z", "text": "May I widen the touches?"}
line = mon_needs.line({"panels": {"coord": {"state": "ok", "data": {"asks": [ask], "asks_open": 1}}}})

clauses.clause: The time kbmon's needs-you line prints for an ask reads `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC`, so a time in UTC is not read as local

notes: Evidence 2026-11-08: 'since 2026-10-27 22:39' is UTC (mon_coord builds the ask's time with time.gmtime, mon_needs.ask_entries prints its first 16 characters) and was read as local 22:39 when it was 23:39 local. Planted check 0 (mon_needs.line over a planted coord panel with one ask) fails on the base: 'ask A1 since 2026-10-27 22:39:' carries no UTC suffix. Scope settled: no panel prints a claim's wall-clock time (the sprint panel's `claimed` is data only, ISO with Z). The landing row's time (`since` in mon_sprint.lines, which prints it with a Z suffix and seconds) is left out: _tools/mon_sprint.py is in BG-cmevtnpk's touches and the two items have no order, so the landing row is a follow-up for the operator to file or fold into BG-cmevtnpk. Other times a panel prints (the delivery's `when`, the snapshot's taken time) are not changed here.
